c="${COOPERA_BIN:-coopera}"; command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 && COOPERA_TOOL=claude-code "$c" hook session-start || echo {}
c="${COOPERA_BIN:-coopera}"; command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 && COOPERA_TOOL=claude-code "$c" hook user-prompt-submit || echo {}
